newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Vale finds gold, copper deposits - paper.
newsitem.headline: Vale finds gold, copper deposits - paper.

text.p: Brazilian state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce has discovered rich gold and copper deposits in the northern state of Para, a local newspaper said.
O Estado de S. Paulo, quoting unnamed government sources, said Vale geologists had found mineralized areas with an average two-percent copper grade and 1.5 grams a tonne of gold, near Carajas.
The paper said preliminary geological studies begun in July were concluded two weeks ago. The mineralization was found 18.6 miles (30 kms) from Vale's open-pit Salobo copper-gold mine.
The world's largest iron ore producer, Vale is slated to be privatized this year.
Brazil is Latin America's largest gold producer.
